author: shunxliu
description: Multi-IDE SVN manager for CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy/Cursor. Syncs and uploads skills, agents, commands, and rules with role-based partitioning (shared/art/ta/dev/user). Auto-detects IDE directory.
changelog:
v4.4.1: Cross-IDE config fallback — load_local_config now probes other known IDE homes (.codebuddy/.workbuddy/.cursor) when the current one has no config, and auto-mirrors the first hit into the current IDE home so users migrating between IDEs no longer need to re-run init_repo.
v4.4.0: Multi-IDE support — auto-detects .codebuddy, .workbuddy, .cursor directories. Env var SKILL_MANAGER_IDE_DIR for explicit override. All scripts now resolve IDE paths dynamically.
